name: Sync funding feeds and verify outreach pipeline renders
description: When a corporate engagement officer opens SponsorPulse and clicks Sync Funding Feed, the feed fetches recent funding news, displays companies in the Discovery Panel with funding badges, and loads the 6-stage Kanban board.

planSteps.description: Click the Sync Funding Feed button in the top navigation bar to trigger news ingestion
Scroll through the Funding Discovery panel on the left

Verify the Funding Discovery panel shows discovered companies with funding details and the Kanban outreach pipeline displays columns for Discovered, Enriched, Drafted, Ready to Send, Sent, and Replied
